enabled.description: Enable the Guest Filesystem Daemon at boot.

user.description: System user to run the guestfsd daemon as for security isolation.

group.description: System group to run the guestfsd daemon as for security isolation.

virtio_path.description: Path to the virtio-serial port device used for communication with the guest VM.

max_mounts.description: Maximum number of concurrent filesystem mounts supported by the daemon.

mount_opts.description: Additional filesystem mount options to apply (e.g., `ro`, `noexec`).

allowed_host_paths.description: Host filesystem paths allowed for bind-mounting into guests. Each entry creates a dedicated environment variable.

systemd_env_dir.description: Optional path to a systemd drop-in directory for custom environment overrides (e.g., `/etc/systemd/system/guestfsd.service.d/env`).
